items.title: Why Reddit Stock Is In Focus After Strong Q3 And A Google Traffic Warning
items.summary: Reddit reported Q3 2026 revenue of US$894.96 million and net income of US$283.26 million, alongside a completed US$340.37 million share repurchase covering 1.15% of shares. The business paired stronger earnings with a warning about lower daily users and weaker Google search referrals, while preparing a logged in only platform that concentrates on the audience already driving most monetization. We will now examine how Reddit's investment narrative is affected by the sharp Google search...
